Immediate Operator Guidance: Verify the reported property or asset incident, identify any immediate safety concerns, and initiate the appropriate authorized security response.
Coordination / Notification: Notify the relevant security, property-control, or supervisory authority where required.
Scene / Evidence Considerations: Protect the affected area from unnecessary disturbance and preserve available incident details, records, or physical evidence for follow-up.
Escalation / Follow-up: Document losses or damage, record responsible parties where known, and refer the case for investigation or recovery action as appropriate.

Immediate Operator Guidance: Prioritize the safety of affected personnel, verify the incident circumstances, and initiate an authorized personnel-safety response.
Coordination / Notification: Coordinate with appropriate medical, security, supervisory, or investigative authorities depending on the seriousness of the incident.
Scene / Evidence Considerations: Preserve relevant incident information and avoid unnecessary disturbance of material that may be required for investigation.
Escalation / Follow-up: Escalate High or Critical incidents promptly through the appropriate command or supervisory channel and ensure the case is formally recorded.

Immediate Operator Guidance: Verify the reported facts, secure relevant documentation or digital records, and initiate the appropriate administrative or investigative process.
Coordination / Notification: Notify the responsible administrative, supervisory, security, or investigative authority as required.
Scene / Evidence Considerations: Maintain integrity of records, statements, digital information, and other material relevant to the incident.
Escalation / Follow-up: Create a traceable case record, assign the matter for review or investigation, and monitor it until appropriate closure.

Immediate Operator Guidance: Treat the incident as a controlled-substance and security matter, verify available information, and initiate the appropriate authorized response.
Coordination / Notification: Coordinate with designated security, investigative, medical, or supervisory authorities where required.
Scene / Evidence Considerations: Avoid unnecessary handling of suspected substances and preserve relevant material and documentation for authorized examination.
Escalation / Follow-up: Record the incident, preserve chain-of-custody information where applicable, and refer the matter for investigation or further authorized action.

Immediate Operator Guidance: Verify the vehicle or mobility-related incident, identify immediate safety or access concerns, and initiate the appropriate authorized security response.
Coordination / Notification: Coordinate with transport, traffic, security, supervisory, or investigative authorities as appropriate.
Scene / Evidence Considerations: Preserve vehicle details, registration information, location information, and other relevant incident evidence.
Escalation / Follow-up: Record affected vehicles or assets, document movement restrictions where applicable, and refer the incident for investigation or recovery action.

Immediate Operator Guidance: Handle the incident with increased sensitivity, restrict unnecessary disclosure, and refer it to appropriately authorized personnel.
Coordination / Notification: Notify only the relevant supervisory, specialist, welfare, medical, security, or investigative authority required for the case.
Scene / Evidence Considerations: Protect privacy, maintain confidentiality, and preserve relevant evidence or records using appropriate handling procedures.
Escalation / Follow-up: Ensure controlled documentation, appropriate specialist referral, and supervised case follow-up.

Immediate Operator Guidance: Treat the incident as a significant safety and security matter, prioritize protection of personnel, and initiate the appropriate authorized security response.
Coordination / Notification: Promptly notify the responsible security and supervisory authorities and request specialist assistance where required.
Scene / Evidence Considerations: Limit unnecessary access to the affected area and preserve relevant weapons-related evidence for authorized handling and investigation.
Escalation / Follow-up: Escalate according to incident priority, create a complete incident record, and refer the matter for appropriate security or investigative follow-up.

Immediate Operator Guidance: Assess the immediate public-order or disciplinary impact, reduce further disruption, and initiate the appropriate authorized response.
Coordination / Notification: Coordinate with the responsible supervisory, security, administrative, or disciplinary authority.
Scene / Evidence Considerations: Record relevant observations, statements, CCTV references, or other information needed for subsequent review.
Escalation / Follow-up: Document the incident and refer it for administrative, disciplinary, or investigative action where appropriate.

Immediate Operator Guidance: Prioritize the immediate safety and welfare of the vulnerable person and minimize unnecessary exposure or distress.
Coordination / Notification: Notify appropriate welfare, medical, supervisory, protective, or investigative authorities as required.
Scene / Evidence Considerations: Protect privacy and preserve relevant information while limiting unnecessary disclosure of sensitive personal details.
Escalation / Follow-up: Ensure appropriate safeguarding referral, formal documentation, and supervised follow-up of the case.

Immediate Operator Guidance: Prioritize life safety, verify the reported fire or major threat, and initiate the appropriate authorized emergency response.
Coordination / Notification: Notify relevant emergency, fire-safety, security, and supervisory authorities without unnecessary delay.
Scene / Evidence Considerations: Maintain safe access control around the affected area and preserve relevant information or evidence once immediate safety requirements have been addressed.
Escalation / Follow-up: Escalate High or Critical incidents through the appropriate authority, maintain an incident record, and support subsequent investigation and recovery activities.
